title: So glad they were able to get the theater back up and running so quic...
transcript: We now have an update on when book of Mormon is expected to reopen on Broadway after the fire destroyed part of the theatre last Monday. And it's good news as the show is expected to resume performances on Thursday, May 21st, with the box office reopening tomorrow. And they're actually doing a small box office reopening event tomorrow starting at 10:00am where the first 50 people in line will be able to buy 15 dollar tickets to select upcoming performances in Celebration of the show's upcoming 15 year anniversary in June. And I'm just so glad that they were able to get this resolved relatively quickly and that everyone will be able to get back to work in only a couple weeks. Massive shout out to everyone that has been working around the clock to get this theatre back in operating condition. All of the firefighters that fought the fire and were able to contain it before it became a bigger deal, they are all heroes and I will continue to sing their praises. And if you had a ticket to book of Mormon anytime between now and May 20th, you should be able to work with your point of purchase to either get a full refund or rebook for another performance. And if you're in New York, definitely take advantage of that 15 dollar ticket deal. That might just be the cheapest Broadway ticket you will ever buy.
classificationReason: News update about Book of Mormon reopening after a theater fire; no first-hand opinion on the production itself.
